description: Production semantic vocabulary for Vibrante cinematic orchestration. Defines known workflow identities, their orchestration purpose, and artistic intent. Claude must choose from these known workflows — never invent arbitrary node graphs.
usage: Load via SemanticVocabulary.load(). Use vocabulary entries to guide plan_scene, goal decomposition, and review scoring.

cinematic_explosion.label: Cinematic Explosion
cinematic_explosion.description: Full-scale cinematic explosion with fireball, billowing smoke, pressure-wave dust and secondary debris. Designed for film/VFX shot context.
cinematic_explosion.orchestration_purpose: Primary destruction FX — detonation event, missile/bomb impact, structural collapse initiation.

stage_descriptions.terrain_prep: Analyze and prepare ground geometry for interaction — grid, collision, ground-scatter seeding.
stage_descriptions.pyro_source: Pyro source sphere/cluster defining the ignition volume, radius, and initial temperature/density seed values.
stage_descriptions.fireball_core: Dense fireball simulation — high temperature, luminance, tight radius that expands outward in frames 1–30.
stage_descriptions.smoke_evolution: Layered smoke rising from fireball — temperature cooling, turbulence, buoyancy, breakup variation at 3+ scales.
stage_descriptions.pressure_wave: Radial ground-level pressure/dust displacement wave — ring-shaped, ground-plane constrained, fast early / slow decay.
stage_descriptions.secondary_debris: Rigid-body debris — rock, metal, organic fragments launched outward from epicenter with variation in scale/rotation.
stage_descriptions.dust_interaction: Ground dust disturbed by pressure wave — thin layer, swept outward, interacts with debris.
stage_descriptions.lighting_setup: Cinematic explosion lighting — key/rim from fireball with orange-to-white gradient, secondary fill, volumetric shadows.
stage_descriptions.camera_framing: Anticipation move + recoil shake + slow-motion reveal pull-out for cinematic read.
stage_descriptions.render_setup: Arnold / Karma render setup — AOVs, motion blur, volume sampling, depth-of-field, tone-mapping.

artistic_goals: Fireball must read as luminous, expanding, hot — not a flat sphere.
Smoke must have asymmetric billowing — no uniform puffball.
Pressure wave must be visible at ground level.
Debris must vary in scale — large boulders near, fine particles far.
Camera must anticipate the event and recoil on impact.
Final frame must be cinematic — readable silhouette against sky.
cinematic_explosion.scale_reference: Explosion radius 5–25m for hero shot. Scale up for distance shots.
cinematic_explosion.execution_notes: Always decompose — do not attempt in a single orchestration step. Fireball before smoke, smoke before lighting, lighting before camera.

missile_impact.label: Missile Impact
missile_impact.description: High-velocity projectile ground-strike FX — fast initial flash, crater ejecta, rising smoke column, shockwave.
missile_impact.orchestration_purpose: Combat/military FX, sci-fi destruction, action sequence impact.
artistic_goals: Flash must be extremely fast — 2–4 frames of peak luminance.
Ejecta must have high directionality — outward and upward cone.
Smoke column must rise with momentum — not diffuse immediately.
Shockwave ring must be visible at ground plane.
missile_impact.execution_notes: Impact event is fast — prioritize temporal precision. Use sub-frame timing for flash.

debris_field.label: Secondary Debris Field
debris_field.description: Rigid-body debris — rock, concrete, metal — distributed outward from an explosion epicenter.
debris_field.orchestration_purpose: Secondary FX layer for any explosion or structural collapse. Adds ground-level detail and cinematic scale.
artistic_goals: Debris must have scale variation — hero chunks near camera, fine rubble far.
Tumbling motion must feel physically weighted.
Dust tail on large pieces for visual trail.

dust_wave.label: Rolling Dust Wave
dust_wave.description: Ground-level rolling dust displacement wave driven by a pressure source. Reads as atmospheric scale.
dust_wave.orchestration_purpose: Secondary atmospheric layer for explosions, vehicle impacts, landslides. Adds ground-level cinematic depth.
artistic_goals: Wave must have sharp leading edge and soft trailing dissipation.
Thin layer hugging the ground — no more than 2m high initially.
Interaction with terrain variation — wave wraps around obstacles.
Color should match terrain — sandy, earthy, not clean white.

smoke_column.label: Smoke Column
smoke_column.description: Rising column of billowing smoke from a burning source. Fully animated with buoyancy, turbulence, and breakup.
smoke_column.orchestration_purpose: Long-duration post-ignition FX. Background atmosphere, slow-burn destruction aftermath.
artistic_goals: Column must narrow at base and billow outward higher up.
Three turbulence scales: micro, mid, macro.
Dark at base (dense), lighter at top (sparse).
No perfect symmetry at any stage.

fuel_fireball.label: Fuel Fireball
fuel_fireball.description: Petroleum/fuel combustion fireball — rolling, sticky, dark-smoke-edged orange-red fireball.
fuel_fireball.orchestration_purpose: Vehicle fire, fuel tank explosion, gas cloud ignition.
artistic_goals: Deep orange-red core, black smoke at outer edges.
Rolling, churning motion — not uniform expansion.
Sticky surface feel — fuel-wet appearance.
Multiple ignition points for organic read.

arnold_cinematic_lighting.label: Arnold Cinematic Lighting
arnold_cinematic_lighting.description: Production-quality Arnold lighting for cinematic FX shots — key/rim separation, volumetric scatter, atmosphere.
arnold_cinematic_lighting.orchestration_purpose: Primary lighting pass for hero FX shots. Required before any render setup.
artistic_goals: Clear key/fill ratio — cinematic contrast, not flat.
Rim separation on hero elements from background.
Volumetric scatter in atmosphere — air feels thick.
Shadows must have penumbra — no hard-edged shadows on organic elements.
Exposure balanced — highlights hold detail, shadows are readable.
arnold_cinematic_lighting.execution_notes: Requires Arnold renderer. Must be set up before render_setup stage.

volumetric_contrast_lighting.label: Volumetric Contrast Lighting
volumetric_contrast_lighting.description: High-contrast volumetric lighting for explosion and smoke environments — godrays, volumetric shadows.
volumetric_contrast_lighting.orchestration_purpose: Enhance depth and drama in volumetric FX elements — smoke, dust, fire.
artistic_goals: Godrays visible through smoke — light scattering feel.
Volumetric shadows cast from pyro onto ground.
Strong directionality — not ambient-only.
Color temperature variation — warm key, cool fill.

night_explosion_lighting.label: Night Explosion Lighting
night_explosion_lighting.description: Explosion lighting in night/low-key environment — fire as primary light source, deep shadows.
night_explosion_lighting.orchestration_purpose: Night-time combat scenes, nocturnal FX shots, dramatic contrast shots.
artistic_goals: Fire is the PRIMARY light source — ground and nearby objects lit orange-red.
Deep blacks outside of fire radius.
Falloff must be physically motivated — sharp distance rolloff.
Night sky visible — no over-lit atmosphere.

cinematic_push_in.label: Cinematic Push In
cinematic_push_in.description: Anticipation-hold-push camera move toward a FX event. Classic film camera move for impact revelation.
cinematic_push_in.orchestration_purpose: Hero FX reveal. Builds tension before detonation, holds on impact, pushes through aftermath.
artistic_goals: Anticipation hold must be minimum 12 frames before event.
Push speed must accelerate — not constant velocity.
Framing must maintain readable silhouette of FX element.
Slight rotation during push for parallax depth.
cinematic_push_in.execution_notes: Camera must be set up after FX elements are placed — requires scene bounds knowledge.

impact_handheld.label: Impact Handheld Shake
impact_handheld.description: Simulated handheld camera recoil on impact — fast violent shake decaying to residual tremor.
impact_handheld.orchestration_purpose: Ground-camera perspective on close-range explosion or impact event.
artistic_goals: Impact frame must have maximum displacement — 5–10% of frame height.
Decay must feel physically weighted — not linear.
High-frequency component on impact, low-frequency residual.
Camera cannot return to exact original position — slight permanent drift.

slow_motion_reveal.label: Slow Motion Reveal
slow_motion_reveal.description: High-frame-rate slow-motion pass on FX element — reveals detail invisible at normal speed.
slow_motion_reveal.orchestration_purpose: Hero detail pass — fireball, debris, pressure wave leading edge.
artistic_goals: Time scale must be 0.1x or lower for cinematic slow-mo.
Motion blur must be enabled — frozen-in-time look is wrong.
Frame range must be extended to match time scale factor.
Focus must follow hero element through frame.

arnold_render_ready.label: Arnold Render Ready
arnold_render_ready.description: Full Arnold render setup — sampling, AOVs, motion blur, volume sampling, output drivers.
arnold_render_ready.orchestration_purpose: Production render pass configuration. Must be final stage before submitting to farm.
artistic_goals: AA samples 8+ for final. 3–4 for preview.
Motion blur must be ON — object and volume blur.
Volume step size appropriate to simulation density.
All required AOVs active: beauty, diffuse, specular, emission, depth, normal.
arnold_render_ready.execution_notes: Requires Arnold license. Check capability registry before setup.

cinematic_aov_setup.label: Cinematic AOV Setup
cinematic_aov_setup.description: Multi-pass AOV configuration for cinematic composite — all passes needed for professional grade comp.
cinematic_aov_setup.orchestration_purpose: Compositing layer setup. Enables downstream color grade and FX enhancement in Nuke/Flame.
artistic_goals: All volumetric elements must have separate emission AOV.
Cryptomatte for per-element masking in comp.
Motion vectors in world space for post motion-blur compositing.
Depth in world units — not normalized.
16-bit or 32-bit EXR only — no 8-bit passes.
